tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with a slightly elevated erythrocyte count and normal red cell indices, suggesting possible early or compensated anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, which may indicate increased platelet size variability, possibly due to reactive or regenerative processes. Further clinical correlation and investigation are recommended.
